sections.title: Welcome
sections.body:
Dear valued Guest,

It is my pleasure welcome to Nazra Hotel, where we strive to make your stay with us a perfect one. Whether you are traveling on business or pleasure, we know you have a choice and are honored that you have selected our hotel. Our professional and friendly staff is committed to ensuring your stay is both comfortable and enjoyable.

I am directly responsible for the room you have been given and take pride in its presentation. It is our intent to provide you with clean and comfortable accommodations where everything is in working order. It is my goal to exceed your expectations and if you feel that this is not the case or if there is anything I can do to make your time in Nazra Hotel more enjoyable please contact me immediately, so I may have an opportunity to correct the problem and address any concerns.

I Want to Thank You for Choosing Nazra Hotel

Sincerely,

General Manager

sections.title: About Nazra Hotel
sections.body:
Nazra hotel offers ultimate comfort and luxury. This 4 star hotel is situated on Gabon Avenue locally known as Meskel flower which is only 5 KM from Addis Ababa international airport.

Nazra’s 30 accommodation rooms are designed to help you relax, our luxurious hotel rooms featuring generous work desk, high speed internet access, cable TV, personal electronic safe, luggage storage space, same day laundry and many more. Natural light floods through full length window providing views to Addis Ababa’s city.

Nazra-Taste Where stylish, yet informal dining awaits in the sophisticated panoramic restaurant serves a variety of Ethiopian and European dishes.

Additional service includes free airport shuttle service, business center, and high speed wireless internet connection and meeting rooms. Valet parking and chauffer transfers are also available.

sections.title: Airport
sections.body: The airport is located only about ten minutes’ drive away from our hotel. But as a normal procedure, you are required to reach at the airport two hours before your flight. Hence, may you need to use our shuttle, kindly book good time in advance by dialing reception on “0”.

sections.title: Baby Cot
sections.body: Please be aware that we provide baby cot for your child up on request.

sections.title: Bar and Restaurant
sections.body:
Our hotel has fully fledged 24 hours open top view Bars & Restaurant for you to pass relaxed moments while having selection of drinks (hot & cold), snacks & proper dining.

They are located on the 10th floor of the building.

sections.title: Beds (Extra)
sections.body: Depending on your room type and request, extra beds can be provided in your room except in twin bed rooms with an additional charge of 2000birr/bed.

sections.title: Bell Attendants
sections.body: The bell attendants are positioned at reception and will help you with your luggage & other errands. If you need help to bring your luggage down, please do not hesitate to contact the Bell Attendants desk by dialing 0. The bell attendants also control the luggage room; the place where we temporarily store your luggage after checkout.

sections.title: Breakfast
sections.body:
Buffet Breakfast is available in our main restaurant on the 10th floor

Monday – Friday : - from 06፡30am to 10:00am

Saturday & Sunday: - from 06፡30am to 10፡30am

To order breakfast in your room please dial Room Service on 147.Kindly note that it is only continental or full breakfast available for room service (not to be picked from the buffet) & please be aware that there is an additional charge of 200 birr for room service. Kindly check the menu for details. For further detail, please contact room service on 147.

sections.title: Check Out Time
sections.body: Check out time is 12 noon. If you wish to extend your check out time please contact reception. Extended check out time is subject to availability and there will be at least half charge to use the room until 06pm or full charge afterwards. Please note that the minimum half charge is 50% OF THE ROOM PRICE.

sections.title: Credit Cards
sections.body: Our hotel accepts Visa & Master cards.

sections.title: Credit Limit
sections.body: You are kindly requested to settle your bill in advance. If you have a credit service privilege, you are kindly required to settle your bill before the amount reaching the maximum credit limit of ETB (Ethiopian Birr) 5000(five thousand Birr). Only applicable for room guest.

sections.title: Currency Exchange
sections.body: All major foreign currencies (mostly Euro, US dollar & British Pound) can be exchanged at reception.

sections.title: Electrical Supply & Voltage
sections.body: The hotel electrical supply is 220V. If you require reducer or adopter, please dial Reception 9. You are kindly requested to return the adapter to reception after use. There is a replacement charge of 3 (three) USD otherwise

sections.title: Emergency Numbers
sections.body: In case of emergency, please contact reception on “0”.

sections.title: Fire Precautions /Emergency Evacuation
sections.body: In case of fire, leave your room immediately and use only the stairs through an emergency exit. Never use elevators during fire!!

sections.title: Internet
sections.body: We have Wireless (Wi-Fi) internet services both in public areas & in our guest rooms.

sections.title: Keys
sections.body: Please leave your room key at reception desk by the time you go out from the hotel. In case you lose it, Kindly note that you will cover a replacement charge of 1500birr (15 USD).

sections.title: Lost & Found
sections.body: As a normal precaution, please make sure that you safeguard your property especially valuable items keeping them in the right place (safe box for money & valuables). The hotel will not be held liable for your lost items otherwise. To manage lost & found items, our hotel has a set procedure to be applied by all concerned staffs. To claim a lost & found item, please communicate with either front desk or housekeeping staffs.

sections.title: Luggage Service & Storing
sections.body: Please contact reception on “0” for luggage collection. It is possible to store a limited amount of luggage in our luggage store. However, please ensure that items are properly locked and labeled. Never leave valuables & fragile items in your luggage for storage; the hotel does not take liability in case of theft or breakage.

sections.title: Maintenance
sections.body: It is our sincere objective to keep the hotel facilities in a perfect technical condition, however, it may happen that our staffs overlooked a problem and we would like to apologies if this is the case. The hotel provides 24 hours maintenance support. Please call reception on “0” in cases you encounter a maintenance issue.

sections.title: Meeting Space
sections.body: We have meeting rooms please contact the operation manager on 156 who will advise you of the details.

sections.title: Messages
sections.body: All messages addressed to you will be personally delivered to your room by a hotel porter.  However, in case you are not available then a message card will be hung on your door knob which will inform you that you have a message waiting at reception. Please call reception should you wish to have the message delivered.

sections.title: Mini Bar
sections.body: The mini bar is refilled on a daily basis. Please ensure when you take something from the mini bar that you fill in the mini bar slip and sign, so that the correct amount can be charged to your room account. Drinks purchased outside the hotel are not allowed to be stored in the mini bar, as this prevents the mini bar personnel satisfactorily restocking the mini bar.

sections.title: Parking
sections.body: We have reasonably enough parking area around our premises.

sections.title: Room Account
sections.body: For a draft print out of your room account please contact Reception by dialing “0”.

sections.title: Room Service
sections.body: There is an extensive 24hour room service menu; it is located in your room. Please dial 147 to make an order.

sections.title: Safety Deposit Box
sections.body: In every room there is an electronic safety deposit box. User manual is available on the safe. The Hotel management takes no responsibility for items lost or stolen from a room if it has not been placed in the safety deposit box. Please ensure that the safe door is properly locked before you leave your room. On check out, please leave the safe open.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Ethiopia is perhaps one of the safest countries in the world and Ethiopians are very friendly and helpful people. The staffs at the Nazra Hotel are well trained and educated, however, there can be dishonest people and we strongly advise that you take the normal precaution every time & lock door and window when leaving the room or when you are sleeping.

sections.title: Shops
sections.body: Just a walking distance you find variety of shops and malls. For more information or assistance, please contact front desk/reception

sections.title: Taxis
sections.body: There is taxi station just in front of the hotel, but if you need taxi any time, please call reception on “0” and the on duty front desk staff will organize same for you.

sections.title: Television
sections.body: There are varieties of channels international & few local channels. If you encounter with a problem on receiving any of the channels, please call Reception by dialing “0”.

sections.title: Visitors/Extra person
sections.body: Based on our hotel’s policy of maximum occupancy for each room type, if you may have a visitor to share your room, please note that 2000birr extra charge/person/day will apply for each visit particularly. As a basic mutual security procedure, your visitor needs to be registered at front desk presenting an official ID card.

sections.title: Wake Up Calls
sections.body: Please book your wakeup call through the operator extension “0” or by contacting Reception.
